request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and intimate, piano, acoustic guitar, strings, soft drums, mood of gentle revelation, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jesus spoke to those who believed
Who had gathered near the temple gate
He said if you remain in my word
You are truly my disciples then

[Chorus]
If you abide in my word
You are truly my disciples then
And you will know the truth
And the truth will set you free

[Verse]
They said we are Abraham’s seed
We have never been slaves at all
How can you say we will be free
When we have stood so long in the hall

[Chorus]
If you abide in my word
You are truly my disciples then
And you will know the truth
And the truth will set you free

[Verse]
He answered truly truly I tell you
Everyone who commits sin is a slave
A slave does not remain in the house
But a son remains forever in grace

[Chorus]
If you abide in my word
You are truly my disciples then
And you will know the truth
And the truth will set you free

[Outro]
Remain in my word
The truth will set you free
